findings.title: Existing exit code for recreate upgrade changed from 4 to 3
findings.body: RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE moves from 4 to 3, and 4 is reused for FEATURE_DISABLED. Scripts and pipelines that already treat 4 as "recreate required" will now misread "feature disabled" as a recreate result, and will miss real recreate results. The change is intentional (it avoids picocli codes 1 and 2), but any other code that hard-codes 4 or 3 must be updated. The Operator is a likely candidate, because it runs the check and interprets the exit code.

findings.title: Feature-disabled path tested only for the metadata command
findings.body: The new feature-disabled guard is also added to UpdateCompatibilityCheck. The only test, testFeatureNotEnabled, launches just the metadata subcommand and checks only the stderr message. It does not assert exit code 4, and nothing covers the check command. A regression in the check guard, or a wrong exit code, would go unnoticed.
